units.source_text: “难道是前一阵，在画舫上和胖太太在一起的人？

en.t: Could it be the man who was with the plump lady on the pleasure boat some time ago?

units.source_text: 不是的，那个人的头发更加发红。

en.t: No, it was not; that man's hair was even redder.

units.source_text: 或者，可能是在秦淮夫子庙前面拍照的人，

en.t: Or perhaps it was the man taking photographs in front of the Confucius Temple at Qinhuai,

units.source_text: 但是那人比眼前这位年纪大多了。

en.t: but that man was much older than the one before her now.

units.source_text: 亦或是，在利涉桥边的饭馆前面棒打人力车夫的人，

en.t: Or could it have been the man who beat a rickshaw puller with a stick in front of the restaurant by Lishe Bridge,

units.source_text: 那个人倒是和他非常相像，

en.t: that man did indeed look very much like him,
and at the time there were many people gathered around watching,

units.source_text: 他那这个粗滕杖使劲打人力车夫的背……

en.t: as he struck the rickshaw puller's back hard with that thick rattan cane...

units.source_text: 不是的，那个人的眼珠要比眼前这位蓝得多。”

en.t: No, that was not him; that man's eyes were much bluer than this man's.”
